iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        // Update all elements\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n            const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n            const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[i];\n            const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n            \n            // Start with external flow\n            val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;\n            \n            // Add flux from all connected elements\n            for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n                const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n                const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[neighbor_idx];\n                total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn, elem_static.connected_flux[j], neighbor_dyn);\n            }\n            \n            // Update element state\n            ElementDynamic& elem_write = world.elements_dynamic_swap[i];\n            elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n            elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);\n        }\n        \n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);\n    }\n}","newString":"void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    if (n_iters <= 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const ElementStatic* elems_static = world.elements_static.data();\n    const Material* materials = world.materials.data();\n    ElementDynamic* buf_a = world.elements_dynamic.data();\n    ElementDynamic* buf_b = world.elements_dynamic_swap.data();\n\n    // A single parallel region spans all iterations. Each thread tracks the\n    // read/write buffer pointers locally; they stay in lockstep because every\n    // thread performs the same number of swaps. The implicit barrier at the end\n    // of each \"omp for\" guarantees all writes to the new state are complete\n    // before any thread reads them in the next iteration (Jacobi semantics).\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const ElementDynamic* src = buf_a;\n        ElementDynamic* dst = buf_b;\n\n        for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n            // Update all elements. Each element writes only dst[i] and reads\n            // src[] (read-only in this phase), so iterations are independent.\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n                const ElementStatic& elem_static = elems_static[i];\n                const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = src[i];\n                const Material& mat = materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n\n                // Start with external flow\n                val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;\n\n                // Add flux from all connected elements\n                for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n                    const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n                    const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn = src[neighbor_idx];\n                    total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn, elem_static.connected_flux[j], neighbor_dyn);\n                }\n\n                // Update element state\n                ElementDynamic& elem_write = dst[i];\n                elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n                elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);\n            }\n\n            // Swap buffers (thread-local pointers only)\n            std::swap(src, dst);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // After n_iters swaps the latest state lives in buf_a when n_iters is even\n    // and in buf_b when odd. Match the original vector-swap semantics so that\n    // world.elements_dynamic always holds the latest state.\n    if (n_iters % 2 == 1) {\n        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);\n    }\n}"},"output":"Edit applied successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"diff":"Index: /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r3/unstructured/unstructured.cpp\n===================================================================\n--- /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r3/unstructured/unstructured.cpp\n+++ /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r3/unstructured/unstructured.cpp\n@@ -117,33 +117,61 @@\n \n // Run simulation for n_iters iterations\n void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n     const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n-    \n-    for (int iter = 0;
